title: Page 9
content_zh:
她立刻尖声惊叫起来，四处一看，更是脸色惨白得厉害，眼珠子都要瞪掉了。
不知为何，她居然睡在一张床上，床边跪了个光着脊背的男人，而她一丝不挂，正对着红着眼的童老爷。
“这是哪儿，我怎么在这里？”
“贱人，你做的好事！居然还想赖账？”童老爷狠命扯了童夫人的头发，还想把她拖到地上，但见她赤着上半身，觉得丢脸，只能死死掐了两把出气。
那光着脊背的男人却趁着这个功夫，爬起来一溜烟的跑了出去。
刘良和几个丫鬟婆子不知是看傻了眼，还是一时没有反应过来，居然没有一人伸手拦阻男人。
倒是另外两个陌生男女，恼怒不已，嚷道：“童老爷，你要教训媳妇儿，尽管回家去。我们家虽然是小门小户，但也容不得这样的脏污事。今日之事，还要童家给我们个说法，否则，我们就是告去京兆尹那儿也要讨个公道！擅闯民宅，通奸纳诟，简直是无耻至极！”
原来，这对陌生男女是院子的主人孙家夫妻，他们方才探亲归来，刚到家门口，童老爷就带了奴仆怒气冲冲找来，咬定他们藏了他的妻子，结果，两方对峙，进院子寻人，就见童夫人同一个男子赤条条躺在正房的床上。
童老爷本来是回家拿银钱，找不到妻子，闺女又不肯说，碰巧见到路婆子一副鬼鬼祟祟的样子，逼问之下，路婆子就指了这里。他还以为妻子出了事，带了奴仆来帮忙，没想到丢了这么大的一个脸！
童夫人这会儿好不容易穿了大半衣衫，也听出简单的原委，她哪里肯认通奸，赶紧辩驳道：“老爷，我没有通奸，我来这里是有正事，我没有对不起你啊！”
那孙家媳妇儿眼见床上凌乱，想起这是她平日起居之处，简直恶心不已，说话也就越发难听。
“童夫人这话说得真是好笑，光着身子的男女躺在一起，难道是在研习圣贤书不成？童夫人就是不要脸皮，也别把我们都当傻子。你这是知道我们家里空着，专门跑来占便宜，真是好算计！”
童老爷也是气疯了，他今日回家取银子也是临时起意，并没有受人引导，一路找到这里，也没有任何蹊跷，他怎么能相信妻子是被设计的？再想起平日他三五日不在家，妻子也没有一丝一毫的不满，原来是在外边也有了情夫啊！
他暴怒得像一头老虎，喊了刘良几个扯了被子，把童夫人卷起，就扛回童家。
盛怒中，童老爷也忘了安抚孙家夫妇，更没有提出什么补偿封口，毕竟他本就不是什么精明之人，否则也不会混迹官场半辈子还是五品小官。
孙家夫妇憋气窝火，又没拿到好处，哪里会替童家遮羞，于是左右邻居听到动静，问到头上的时候，他们就“大略”说了几句……
童家院子里，童老爷拿着戒尺打得童夫人鬼哭狼嚎，童芊芊想护着母亲又怕疼，最后就抱着童老爷的胳膊，求情道——
“爹，娘是被人算计了！娘不是去偷人，娘是……是去找人谈笔生意。”
“放屁！什么生意要光着身子谈？”童老爷越说越气，手下打得也就越发厉害。
童芊芊没有办法，只能说道：“娘是看不过那个小贱人药铺生意好，才想给她寻点儿麻烦，一定是那个贱人提前知道了，反过来算计我娘。爹，您一定要给娘做主啊！”

“胡扯！药铺生意好坏，和你们有什么关系？吴家倒楣了，咱们家里没受到牵连，那是悠悠求了梁大人照顾，你们不感激就算了，怎么还要算计她？就是这个贱人偷人，说不定你也跑不了，你什么都知道，就瞒着我一个！”
童老爷手里的戒尺挥个不停，这次连闺女也一起打，童芊芊当下抱头鼠窜，别说再替母亲求情，跑得比谁都快。
童夫人被打得像猪头一般，最后被关进柴房。
童老爷喝得大醉，抱了个有意上位的丫鬟，折腾了半晚。待早晨醒过酒来，他才想起孙家那边还没善后。
他又怕丢脸，于是吩咐刘良拿了银子去善后。结果刘良不改雁过拔毛的本性，一百两银子被他克扣成了二十两。
孙家虽然是小门户，但不缺这二十两，当场气得暴跳如雷。不过最后，夫妻俩还是收了银子。
刘良以为事情办妥，美滋滋的回了童家大院。哪里知道，孙家立刻卖了让他们恶心的院子，直接搬走。
离开之前同街坊们辞行，说起搬走的原因。
于是，童老爷在不知情的情况下被戴了绿帽子的事，已经成了街头巷尾的热门话题。
待童老爷因为衙门一件小事，不得不出门的时候，才知道他成了京都的“红人”。
他真是一口血喷出三尺远，当下公务也不管了，回家把童夫人又打了一顿，捆绑好，扔上马车，一封休书就要把童夫人休回娘家。
能屈能伸的童夫人昨晚“冷静”了一晚，只能认栽。
这会儿，她再也不指望童老爷念在多年夫妻的情分上如何心软，直接祭出最后的杀手锏——
“童德中，这么多年放印子钱的账册我藏在了别处，那上面每一页都有你的私章，你敢把我休了，我托付的人就会把账册送去衙门。我不好过，你也别想做你的官老爷！”
“贱人，你好大的胆子！”童老爷暴跳如雷，无奈被掐了命脉，到底还是要顾及几分。
童芊芊不能想象没了母亲，她以后要怎么办，赶紧跪倒抱了父亲的大腿求情，“呜呜，爹，您不要休了娘啊！我以后还要嫁人，没了娘，我怎么办？爹，把娘送去老家……对，送去台州老家，那里没人知道这些事，过几年再把娘接回来就好了。”
这话倒是有几分道理，童老爷想了想，就收了休书，改写了一封书信，交给刘良，又点了两个婆子要她们一起送童夫人回台州老家反省。
刘良苦着脸，跑去寻商队结伴，幸好如今是夏秋交接，南北来往商队很多，倒也不算难找。
当日下午，童夫人就被迫踏上前往台州的道路。
她进童家门之后，还是第一次回台州，却是以这样屈辱的方式，别提心里有多愤恨了，她暗暗发誓，一定要尽早回来，洗清冤屈，还要报仇雪恨。

可惜，事与愿违。她才离开京都不到二百里，自觉无脸见人，称病在家的童老爷就被同僚拉去喝酒。
半醉间，童老爷寻找茅厕不得，误闯了同僚侄女的闺房，冲撞了正在洗澡的姑娘，害那姑娘闹着要自杀。
同僚也是暴怒，最后在其余友人的说合下，童老爷娶了人家姑娘做平妻。
童芊芊没了母亲疼爱，父亲又不着家，初始她还忐忑不安，但慢慢地体会到了当家做主的乐趣，还有些欲罢不能。
没想到，父亲居然火速下聘，娶回一个继母。
这继母年轻貌美，难得琴棋书画样样精通又温柔可人，进门两三日就哄得童老爷恨不得日日黏在家里，管家大权自然也交了出去。
新夫人很是聪明，借口为了保住童老爷的官位，放出消息，童家从来没有放过印子钱，一切账册和欠条都是假的，以此免了很多外边的欠债，损失自然是有，可也彻底绝了后患。
童家的家底大半做了童芊芊的嫁妆，小半在外边没讨要回来，这般之后，童家是彻底的穷了。
content_en:
She immediately screamed and looked around, her face was so pale that her eyes almost popped out.
For some reason, she actually slept on a bed, and a man with a bare back knelt beside the bed. She was naked, facing Master Tong with red eyes.
"Where is this and why am I here?"
"Bitch, you've done such a good job! You still want to default on your debt?" Mr. Tong violently pulled Mrs. Tong's hair and tried to drag her to the ground. However, seeing that her upper body was naked, he felt embarrassed and could only pinch her twice to vent his anger.
The man with the bare back took advantage of this moment, got up and ran out quickly.
Liu Liang and several maids and women didn't know whether they were dumbfounded or didn't react for a moment, but no one reached out to stop the man.
On the other hand, the other two strange men and women were very angry and shouted: "Mr. Tong, if you want to teach your wife a lesson, just go home. Although our family is a small family, we cannot tolerate such dirty things. We need the Tong family to give us an explanation for today's incident, otherwise, we will go to Jing Zhaoyin to seek justice! Trespassing into other people's houses and committing adultery to accept criticism is simply shameless!"
It turned out that the strange man and woman were the Sun family couple who owned the yard. They had just returned from visiting relatives. As soon as they arrived at the door of the house, Mr. Tong came angrily with his servants and insisted that they had hidden his wife. As a result, the two parties confronted each other. When they went into the yard to look for someone, they saw Mrs. Tong and a man lying naked on the bed in the main room.
Mr. Tong was going home to get some money, but he couldn't find his wife, and his daughter refused to talk. He happened to see Mrs. Lu looking sneaky, and when pressed, Mrs. Lu pointed here. He thought something had happened to his wife and brought a servant to help, but he didn't expect to lose such a big face!
Mrs. Tong, who had finally put on most of her clothes now, could tell the simple story. How could she admit adultery? She quickly argued: "Master, I didn't commit adultery. I came here for business, and I didn't feel sorry for you!"
Seeing the mess on the bed, the Sun family's daughter-in-law felt disgusted when she remembered that this was where she usually lived, and her words became even more unpleasant.
"Mrs. Tong's words are really funny. A naked man and woman are lying together, are they studying the books of sages? Mrs. Tong is shameless, and don't treat us all as fools. You know that our house is empty, and you came here to take advantage. What a good plan!"
Mr. Tong was also mad. He went home to collect the money today on a spur-of-the-moment basis and was not guided by anyone. He found nothing strange all the way to this place. How could he believe that his wife was set up? Then I remembered that he was not at home for three to five days on weekdays, and his wife did not feel dissatisfied at all. It turned out that he also had a lover outside!
He was as furious as a tiger. He called Liu Liang and others to pull off the quilt, rolled up Mrs. Tong, and carried her back to Tong's house.
In his rage, Mr. Tong also forgot to appease the Sun family and his wife, let alone offer any compensation. After all, he was not a shrewd person, otherwise he would not have stayed in the officialdom for half his life and remained a fifth-rank official.
The Sun family and his wife were holding back their anger and getting no benefits, so they could not cover up the shame of the Tong family. So when the neighbors heard the commotion and asked about it, they said a few words...
In the yard of Tong's house, Master Tong beat Mrs. Tong with a ruler until Mrs. Tong howled like a ghost. Tong Qianqian wanted to protect her mother but was afraid of the pain. In the end, she hugged Master Tong's arm and begged for mercy——
"Dad, Mom has been tricked! Mom is not going to steal someone, Mom is... looking for someone to negotiate a business deal."
"Fart! Why do you have to discuss business naked?" Mr. Tong became angrier as he spoke, and his men beat him harder.
Tong Qianqian had no choice but to say: "My mother couldn't see that the little bitch's drug store was doing well, so she wanted to cause some trouble for her. That bitch must have known about it in advance and plotted against my mother. Dad, you must make the decision for your mother!"
"Nonsense! The business of the drug store is good or bad.What does it have to do with you? The Wu family is in trouble, but our family has not been implicated. It was because Youyou asked Master Liang to take care of her. If you are not grateful, forget it. Why are you plotting against her? Even if this bitch stole someone, you might not be able to escape. You know everything and you just kept it from me! "
Master Tong kept waving the ruler in his hand, and this time he even beat his daughter. Tong Qianqian immediately ran away with her head in her arms, not to mention pleading for her mother, she ran faster than anyone else.
Mrs. Tong was beaten as hard as a pig's head and was finally put in a woodshed.
Mr. Tong got very drunk, hugged a maid who wanted to be in a position of power, and spent a long time tossing it around. When he woke up in the morning, he remembered that the Sun family had not dealt with the aftermath.
He was afraid of being embarrassed, so he asked Liu Liang to take the money to deal with the aftermath. As a result, Liu Liang did not change his nature of plucking the geese's feathers, so he deducted one hundred taels of silver and turned it into twenty taels.
Although the Sun family was a small family, they did not lack these twenty taels, and they became furious on the spot. But in the end, the couple still took the money.
Liu Liang thought that the matter was settled and returned to the Tong family compound happily. Little did they know that the Sun family immediately sold the yard that disgusted them and moved away.
Before leaving, I said goodbye to my neighbors and talked about the reasons for moving away.
Therefore, the matter of Master Tong being cuckolded without knowing it has become a hot topic in the streets.
It was only when Mr. Tong had to go out because of a small matter at the Yamen that he realized that he had become a "popular man" in Kyoto.
He literally spurted out blood three feet away. He ignored his official duties at the moment and went home. He beat Mrs. Tong again, tied her up, threw her into the carriage, and sent Mrs. Tong back to her parents' home with a divorce letter.
Mrs. Tong, who is flexible and flexible, had to "cool down" all night last night and could only admit defeat.
At this moment, she no longer expected Mr. Tong to be soft-hearted due to the years of love between husband and wife, and directly used her final trump card——
"Tong Dezhong, I have hidden the account book where loan sharks have been kept for so many years. Every page of it has your private seal. If you dare to divorce me, the person I entrust will send the account book to the Yamen. I'm having a hard time, and you don't want to be your official! "
"Bitch, you are so brave! "Master Tong was furious. He had no choice but to have his life cut off. He still had to take care of himself.
Tong Qianqian couldn't imagine what she would do in the future without her mother. She quickly knelt down and hugged her father's thigh to plead, "Oh, daddy, please don't divorce your mother!" I will get married in the future. What will I do if I lose my mother? Dad, send your mother to your hometown... yes, send her to your hometown in Taizhou. No one there knows about these things. It will be fine to bring your mother back in a few years. "
There is some truth to this. Mr. Tong thought about it, accepted the divorce letter, rewrote a letter, and gave it to Liu Liang. He also ordered two women to send Mrs. Tong back to her hometown in Taizhou to reflect.
Liu Liang grimaced and ran to look for caravan companions. Fortunately, it was the handover of summer and autumn, and there were many caravans coming from the north and the south, so it was not difficult to find them.
That afternoon, Mrs. Tong was forced to embark on the road to Taizhou.
This was the first time she returned to Taizhou after entering the Tong family, but in such a humiliating way. Not to mention how resentful she felt, she secretly vowed to come back as soon as possible to clear her grievances and take revenge.
Unfortunately, it backfired. She had only left Kyoto less than 200 miles away, and she felt that she had no face to see people. Master Tong, who was said to be ill at home, was taken to drink by her colleagues.
Half drunk, Mr. Tong couldn't find the toilet, so he accidentally broke into the boudoir of his colleague's niece and bumped into the girl who was taking a bath, causing the girl to suicidal.
His colleagues were also furious. Finally, with the help of other friends, Mr. Tong married the girl as his equal wife.
Tong Qianqian lost her mother's love and her father was homeless. She was still uneasy at first, but gradually she realized the joy of being the master of the family, and she still couldn't stop.
Unexpectedly, his father quickly hired a stepmother to marry him.
This stepmother is young and beautiful. She is rare in being proficient in music, chess, calligraphy and painting. She is also gentle and pleasant. She has been in the house for two or three times.He coaxed him so much that Mr. Tong wished he could stay at home every day, so he naturally handed over the power of the housekeeper.
The new wife was very smart. In order to keep Mr. Tong's official position, she let out the news that the Tong family had never loaned loan sharks and that all the account books and IOUs were fake. In this way, she avoided a lot of external debts. Naturally, there were losses, but she also completely eliminated future troubles.
Most of the Tong family's wealth was spent on Tong Qianqian's dowry, and the rest was left outside to ask for it. After this, the Tong family was completely poor.
